note_tweet.text:
The Hon’ble Chief Minister of West Bengal, Shri Suvendu Adhikari, inaugurated India’s largest phenol and acetone manufacturing facility at Haldia Petrochemicals Limited.

This significant milestone is set to further strengthen West Bengal’s industrial growth, attract investments and create new employment opportunities across the state.
